findings.pdf_says: Index entries printed one per line with sub-entries indented beneath their main entry, e.g. 'CHARACTERS' followed by the indented sub-entry 'BLOCK CONTAINS clause, VII-23'
findings.markdown_says: Every entry is a bare line with no list marker, sub-entries only space-indented: 'CHARACTERS' then '  BLOCK CONTAINS clause, VII-23'
findings.why_it_matters: Markdown renders consecutive bare lines as one paragraph, so the whole index page collapses into one run-on line and the entry boundaries and main-entry/sub-entry hierarchy are lost in the rendered document (pages 961-962 use '- ' list items and keep them). The entries and page references themselves match the PDF; the index is informative, not normative.
